integrity: The finite quotient transition graph, monodromy, and claimed numerical checks are reproducible using the packaged Python code and tables. No independent audit or externally verified certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The results concern only the deterministic synchronous five-color firefly rule on labelled complete bipartite graphs. The 961-state quotient is proved exact for this family; independent mathematical audit has not been performed. An unindexed earlier equivalent could exist.
title: An orbit–basin inversion for five-color firefly dynamics on complete bipartite graphs
